scope: shots01-11, 13 existing video units, first round
method: Read original script lines38-46 and each card script_ref; actually opened all 13 contact sheets, four full sampled frames (03 final /05 middle /07 final /09 quarter) and selected keyframes02/05/07/09. Did not read visual_reviews.json.
limits: 5 sampled frames per clip cannot exclude brief flicker, repeated actions between samples or small lip defects.
No audio listened; every pass is visual-only and is not final audiovisual acceptance.
No source card edited, no GPU submitted, no image regenerated.
global_guidance: Modify shot-card fields, then rerun build_prompt.py; never hand-edit derived prompt.
Keep first_frame_strength=1.0. Do not use ineffective negative_prompt/ref_images.
Every proposed retry consumes the existing three-round unit budget.
Before expensive full rerender, consider audio-verified tail trim for06_u2; no retake exact window asserted from sparse samples.
No current unconditional L2 escalation: the identified hard failures were introduced during video motion;09 has a conditional L2 path if its explicit prop correction fails.

05/04_u2/06_u2 are optional polishing proposals, not mandatory scene-faithfulness failures. A little extra head/shoulder acting is not itself a failure; retain them if continuous playback and the cut are acceptable.

script_source.txt 第45行「陈野（愣了）：你知道？」——陈野意外于他的冷静判断。
角色依据：江砚24岁、地质专业优等生，内敛孝顺；陈野讲义气且直率；苏慧48岁、长期寄人篱下而谨慎；刘兰傲慢、顾瑶轻视穷亲戚。监狱段江砚已遭背叛，机场至客房是初到非洲闪回，不预演后续知情。
验收标准：陈野意外于他的冷静判断。
evidence: 陈野表情从凝视到眼睑/嘴角略动再发出短问，保持对江砚注意；无欢笑、离场或身份变化。
尾部略靠近和江砚低头尚属对话反应幅度，塑料水瓶与场景维持。
